## Purpose

- [ ] Contact before applying RENA in a rent-a-car company
- [ ] Notify an adaptation or update to a previous adaptation

## Company or individual

For a business deployment, provide the company name. Otherwise, your GitHub identity is sufficient.

## Intended use

Describe how you intend to use RENA and whether operational deployment is planned.

## Adaptations

Summarize the changes made or needed, or state that the software will be used unmodified. A public fork or pull request link is optional.

## Version

Which RENA release or commit are you using?

---

This issue is public. Do not include customer data, credentials, confidential records or private contact details. Renato can reply here.
